test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What recent decision did the Union Cabinet make regarding the Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY scheme on 11 September 2024?

options.text: To extend benefits to all citizens aged 70 and above
To increase the coverage amount for all citizens
To limit coverage to only low-income families

solution:
The correct answer is __**To extend benefits to all citizens aged 70 and above**__.
